description: SwarmMind v0.4 evaluation golden set. Eight offline queries with local source documents and key phrases drawn verbatim from each snippet. No network access is required.

queries.query: What does the Ryzen AI NPU accelerate?

sources.title: Ryzen AI NPU overview
sources.snippet: The Ryzen AI NPU accelerates local inference for small and medium language models. It runs at very low power compared with a discrete GPU.

sources.title: RAG grounding notes
sources.snippet: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds answers in retrieved passages from a private document index. RAG reduces hallucinations compared with an ungrounded model.

sources.title: Lemonade local server
sources.snippet: Lemonade is a local server that exposes OpenAI-compatible chat completion and embedding endpoints. It keeps model weights and inference on the user's machine.

queries.query: Which backend suits a ROCm GPU for parallel workers?

sources.title: ROCm backend guide
sources.snippet: For high-throughput parallel workers a ROCm GPU is usually the best backend, while the NPU is better for low-latency single-stream tasks.

sources.title: Backend selection note
sources.snippet: Backend selection on Lemonade is by model variant: choose the model recipe that was pulled for rocm, vulkan or ryzenai.

queries.query: How does Lemonade keep inference local?

sources.title: Lemonade local server
sources.snippet: Lemonade is a local server that exposes OpenAI-compatible chat completion and embedding endpoints. Tools can remain local-first and private by default.

queries.query: Why report source diversity separately from citation validity?

sources.title: Source diversity rubric
sources.snippet: Source diversity measures how many distinct source types and documents an answer draws upon. Diversity is reported separately from citation precision.

sources.title: Self-preference bias
sources.snippet: Self-preference bias makes a model favour its own output. Use a different, blinded judge and randomized source order; such scores are approximate.

queries.query: How should an evaluation judge avoid bias?

sources.title: Self-preference bias
sources.snippet: To reduce self-preference bias, an evaluation judge should be a different model, blinded to which system produced an answer, and should see sources in randomized order. Such scores are approximate.

queries.query: How does ChromaDB support citation IDs?

sources.title: ChromaDB storage
sources.snippet: ChromaDB stores embeddings in a vector index together with metadata such as the source document id and chunk index. That metadata becomes the stable source id used in citations.

queries.query: What should a reproduction manifest contain?

sources.title: Run manifest spec
sources.snippet: A run manifest records the timestamp, generator and judge models, backends, a config snapshot and the stop reason for each query. It enables a one-command re-run.

sources.title: ROCm backend guide
sources.snippet: For high-throughput parallel workers a ROCm GPU is usually the best backend, while the CPU remains the general fallback.
